observations.content: Budget tracking application for small businesses and freelancers
Built with TypeScript, React frontend, Bun backend with SQLite
Primary user persona is freelance designers tracking project expenses and invoicing clients
Sprint goal: complete CSV import and begin receipt OCR integration
CSV import feature is in progress — parser is done, UI needs file upload component
Receipt OCR integration is next after CSV import — API key provisioned, SDK installed
Expense categories overhaul is blocked — waiting on design review for new taxonomy
Sprint ends April 11, three work days remaining
Restructuring expense categories from flat list to hierarchical tree
Blocked on design review — new taxonomy proposed but not approved
Depends on Sprint 14 CSV import because category mapping is needed for import
